title: The Title label stays the same when a canned line is picked or cleared
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154708 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154708 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • Canned line {Canned-line-A} (for example "Replace - Brake pot") is set up at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1} and go to its Lines tab.
  2. Click New Line.
  3. Read the first field's label and the grey text inside it.
  4. Type the first letters of {Canned-line-A} into the first field (for example Repl).
  5. Read the first field's label and what is inside the box.
  6. Pick {Canned-line-A} from the list.
  7. Read the first field's label and the text beside the picked name.
  8. Clear the picked canned line with the field's clear control.
  9. Read the first field's label and the grey text inside it.
  10. Close the window without saving.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the label reads "Title" and the prompt "What are you doing?" shows inside the box without typing anything.
  • Step 5: the label still reads "Title". The prompt is gone and only the typed letters show.
  • Step 7: the label still reads "Title", not a question such as "What are you doing?". No prompt text sits beside the picked canned line name.
  • Step 9: the label still reads "Title" and the prompt "What are you doing?" shows again in the empty box.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10130 (Story 1, The Work Order Line Dialog); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S1-R3, S1-R4, S1-R5, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.2 (New Line - after) and 1.1 (New Line - before), 13 Oct copy; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-001, FR-003; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R4: “The label does not change with the state of the field. It reads "Title" whether the canned-line picker is empty or filled, which replaces a rule that swapped the label between the question and "Title" depending on that state.”
  • S1-R5: “The canned-line picker at the top of the dialog is labeled "Title" and carries the placeholder "What are you doing?" in its typeahead box, the same as the free-text Title field. The dialog focuses this field on open, so the placeholder is visible the moment the dialog appears and clears as soon as the user types or picks a canned line. (Corrected 2026-09-10: the first build gave the picker no placeholder, so the prompt never appeared on a new line.)”
  • S1-R3: “The Title box carries the placeholder "What are you doing?" and the Description box carries "Why are you doing it?". Placeholder text shows while the box is empty and disappears as soon as there is a value.”
  • SV-10130 acceptance criteria: “Given the New Line dialog is open, then the canned-line picker is labelled "Title" and its typeahead box shows the placeholder "What are you doing?".”
  • SV-10130 acceptance criteria: “Given a canned line has been picked, then the picker label still reads "Title" and does not change to a question.”
